queries.result: First-party discovery found the official SIGFU urban-land parcel portal, AFOR rural geoportal/API, IDUFCI national parcel-identifier information, DGI cadastre materials, and an official Divo cadastral-service directory entry.

registryEvidence.basis: SIGFU is a first-party Ministry urban-land management portal with parcel/lot search; the official cadastre directory lists a decentralized DIVO cadastre service. AFOR is the first-party rural land agency geoportal/API.
registryEvidence.localCustodianScope: The Divo cadastral directory entry evidences a local Divo service, while SIGFU urban coverage and AFOR rural coverage are national systems. Citywide parcel completeness for Divo was not established.

officialSources.observation: Official SIGFU parcel page describes searching approved lotissements/lots by locality and displaying parcel results.
Official AFOR rural geoportal exposes parcel mapping and states that parcels appear after zooming; its current client configuration exposed the public API base https://api.geoportail.afor.ci.
Official directory lists the DIVO cadastral service.
Official IDUFCI information describes a unique identifier intended for Côte d'Ivoire parcels and cadastral/georeferenced information exchange.
